items.t: Rust, including front spring mounts that can tear away from the body
items.job: Weld in new front spring perch (one side)

items.t: Electronic brake system can drop into back-up mode (recall)
items.job: Update or replace brake control unit (SBC)
items.note: Free under recall 04V-296 / 05V-133. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Electronic brake pump unit reaches the end of its service life
items.job: Replace SBC hydraulic brake unit
items.note: Mercedes-Benz USA covers this unit for 25 years; ask a dealer before paying.

items.t: Balance shaft or timing idler gear teeth wear down
items.job: Replace balance shaft and timing chain (engine out)
items.note: The V8 idler gear repair is shorter. The old settlement coverage has mostly expired.

items.t: Air suspension struts and compressor leak or fail
items.job: Replace one air suspension strut
items.note: A worn compressor or valve block adds to the job.

items.t: Diesel emissions settlement repair and extended warranty
items.job: Approved emissions modification (software and parts)
items.note: Free under the 2020 emissions settlement, not an NHTSA recall. Check the VIN with a dealer.

items.t: Driveshaft joint can break on all-wheel-drive models (recall)
items.job: Replace driveshaft
items.note: Free under recall 26V-216. Check the VIN first.

items.t: 48-volt battery fails and the car will not start
items.job: Replace 48-volt battery
items.note: Often covered by warranty; ask the dealer first.

items.t: Infotainment restart can blank the instrument display (recall)
items.job: Update infotainment software
items.note: Free under recall 26V-281. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Glass sunroof panel can come loose and fly off
items.job: Re-bond or replace the glass sunroof panel
items.note: Free under recall 24V-874. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Power steering can lose its fluid (recall)
items.job: Replace leaking power steering line and refill
items.note: Free under recall 10V-459. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Diesel fuel filter can leak
items.job: Replace diesel fuel filter and housing
items.note: Free under recall 11V-496. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Crankshaft vibration damper ring can separate (recall)
items.job: Replace crankshaft vibration damper
items.note: Free under recall 11V-213. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Harsh or jerky automatic gear changes
items.job: Transmission fluid service and shift software update

items.t: Oil can leak from the timing chain tensioner gasket (recall)
items.job: Replace timing chain tensioner gasket
items.note: Free under recall 14V-762. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Diesel oil cooler seals leak oil into the engine valley
items.job: Replace engine oil cooler seals

items.t: Rattle from the engine for a few seconds on a cold start
items.job: Replace camshaft adjusters and secondary chain tensioners

items.t: Transmission wiring connection can corrode and short (recall)
items.job: Repair or replace transmission wiring connector
items.note: Free under recall 24V-445. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Tires marked with the wrong maximum pressure (recall)
items.job: Replace the affected tires
items.note: Free under recall 25V-023. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Loose battery ground connections can overheat (recall)
items.job: Inspect and retighten 12-volt and 48-volt ground connections
items.note: Free under recall 25V-240. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Rear camber strut bracket can break away from the axle carrier (recall)
items.job: Inspect and repair rear camber strut bracket
items.note: Free under recall 24V-941. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Cross-traffic automatic braking can stop working (recall)
items.job: Update infotainment and driver assistance software
items.note: Free under recall 24V-688. Check the VIN first.
